tasks.title: Repo skeleton, Makefile check, CI
accept: make check runs gofmt, go vet, go test ./..., spec-lint (python3 -I tools/o2_lint.py --spec spec --strict, exits 1 on any mechanical finding or a judgment count above tools/o2_lint.baseline.json) and openapi lint; all green on empty repo
Rule-coverage check (tools/rule_coverage.py): every rule id in spec/rules/*.json appears in some task's rule_ids in docs/TASKS.md; one unmapped id fails make check
CI fails if any file under kernel/ or app/legal/ imports another module's <m>/store package (layering test, like Paploo internal/layering)
Unit tests run with no network and no Docker; integration tests carry //go:build integration and read COUNSEL_TEST_DB

tasks.title: Kernel boundary ratchet tests
accept: go list -deps ./kernel/... contains no package under app/: a kernel file importing app/legal/matter fails make check

Legal-term scan over kernel/ (Go identifiers, strings, comments, SQL, YAML, web/src/kernel): every term in tools/kernel_terms.txt (matter, trust, lawyer, licensee, paralegal, solicitor, client ledger, retainer, conflict check, ethical wall, court, docket, HST, GST, QST, LSO, By-Law, Clio, Ontario, bill of costs) fails unless the exact (file, term) is in tools/kernel_allow.txt; test fixture plants 'retainer' in kernel/money and expects failure
Ratchet: kernel_allow.txt and kernel_bindings.txt line counts may only go down; a commit that adds a line fails CI with 'kernel ratchet grew'
kernel_bindings.txt lists every kernel-layer table column that FKs into an app schema (e.g. cal.deadline.matter_id); a new such FK not listed fails the test (read from a4 JSON layer tags)

Gate kind slugs, capability ids, report ids and rule-pack ids registered by app/legal must not use a kernel module prefix (core., gate., platform., audit.); existing core.trust_signatory is the only allowlisted exception (Q-K1)

tasks.title: Import frozen contracts and contract tooling
accept: openapi.yaml = a2-interfaces.openapi.yaml byte-for-byte with CONTRACT header; contract-diff test fails CI when Bill.number is removed or a required field is added to BillCreate (ARC-I-001 test)
0001_init.sql applies cleanly to empty Postgres 16 and a4-data-model.smoke.sql passes; its header lists kernel and app schemas exactly as a4-data-model.json layer tags

spec/kernel/ holds JSON Schemas for the extension data the app registers: gate kind, capability, rule pack, document kind, report definition, portal page, agent tool, retention class; a fixture app (test/fixtures/helpdesk, no legal terms) validates against all of them

tasks.title: kernel/money: int64 cents, rhu, ppm
accept: rhu(-5,10) = -1, rhu(5,10)=1, rhu(4,10)=0 (half away from zero)
Property test: for random a,b,d (|a*b| < 2^62), rhu(a*b,d) equals big.Rat rounding; overflow returns error, never wraps
JSON decode of 12.5 or "1250" into Cents fails (ARC-I-003); MIG-005 parse '1,234.56' -> 123456 without float
go vet analyzer/grep test: no float32/float64 in kernel/ or app/ outside display formatting allowlist
Every rate and percentage type is money.PPM (int64, /1e6); no bp type exists (CF-01)
Allocate(total, weights) by largest remainder is the only split primitive; app rules choose weights and which line absorbs the remainder

tasks.title: kernel ids, clock, number series
accept: Go ids.New() is monotonic within one process (1e5 ids in a tight loop strictly increase); ids from SQL core.uuidv7() sort by millisecond only, and no code relies on order within a millisecond
clock.Today() returns the cell's business date in its configured zone (America/Toronto for Counsel cells): 2026-11-01T03:30Z -> 2026-10-31; DST fall-back day has 25 h

numseq.Next in the caller's tx under SELECT FOR UPDATE: 50 concurrent approvals produce 2026-0001..2026-0050 with no gap; a rolled-back tx does not consume a number (integration); the series name and format are app data

tasks.title: kernel/audit: hash-chained append-only log
accept: Append 3 events; hash[n] = sha256(prev_hash || canonical(row)); verifier detects a flipped byte in row 2
UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE on audit.audit_event raise (integration, triggers audit_immutable/audit_no_truncate)
detail_masked never contains document text, customer names or secrets: fuzz test with seeded secrets asserts redaction (ARC-I-044, ARC-U-040)

tasks.title: kernel/identity: users, roles, teams, capabilities, Can(), RLS session
accept: Capabilities and roles are registered by the app at boot (Registry.Capability, Registry.Role); Can() with the helpdesk fixture's matrix returns every cell exactly
Can(principal, capability, subject) calls the app's SubjectResolver for subject visibility (walls are an app resolver); a resolver that denies -> 404 not 403
Agent principal capabilities = intersection(acting user, skill grant): agent acting for a user without x.approve cannot hold it
No role, including admin and agent, is ever in a gate approver list by default (o2 check approve-forbidden stays 0)
Per-request SET LOCAL app.user_id and app.principal_kind; second request on the same pooled connection sees them empty

tasks.title: kernel outbox, inbox, idempotency keys
accept: Same Idempotency-Key + same body -> stored response replayed byte-identical; same key + different body -> 422 idempotency_mismatch (ARC-I-008)

Money POST without Idempotency-Key -> 400: conformance test enumerates every operation with x-money or x-external-effect, asserts each references #/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey, and asserts count(x-money) >= 20 so it cannot pass empty

Outbox row written in same tx as state change; kill the relay between commit and publish, restart: delivery attempts may be 2, but the consumer applies the effect exactly once (inbox row count 1, effect row count 1)
subject_seq gap-free per subject under 20 concurrent writers (integration)

tasks.title: kernel inbound webhooks inbox
accept: POST /hooks/{provider}: same webhook-id twice -> one platform.inbound_event row and one effect; both calls return 204
Bad signature or timestamp outside 5 min -> 401 and no row
Providers and their event handlers are registered by the app (Registry.InboundProvider); dedup key is (provider, event_id) for every event type, not only payments

tasks.title: kernel/gate: approval engine, decisions, effects
accept: Gate kinds are registered by the app (GateKind{Slug, Risk, MinApprovers, Approver capability, TTL, PayloadSchema, Effect}); an unregistered kind -> 422; slug matches ^[a-z]+\.[a-z_]+$ and its prefix is the registering module
payload_hash = sha256 of RFC 8785 JCS; editing payload creates version n+1 and voids approvals on n (ARC-I-015)
Preparer (creator, editor, agent's acting_for user) deciding -> 403 sod_violation (ARC-I-016); agent principal deciding -> 403 always; decision needs fresh MFA for risk high/irreversible (ARC-I-017)

risk=irreversible with min_approvers=2: one approval leaves status pending; second distinct human approves -> exactly one effect_executions row; replaying final approval -> no second effect (ARC-I-023)
Expired gate (opened_at + ttl) never runs effect (ARC-I-022)
Replay (relay at-least-once) the effect of one approved gate 3 times concurrently -> exactly 1 gate.effect_execution row and 1 effect call (RV2-004)
Amount above decider authority_limit counts as recommend only (ARC-I-020); effect handlers re-check preconditions at execution (ARC-I-024)
The engine has one self-approval hook (SelfApprovalPolicy) that defaults to deny; only the app may supply one

tasks.title: kernel HTTP server, problem+json, ETag, cursor paging, route registration
accept: PATCH without If-Match -> 428; stale If-Match -> 412 (ARC-I-006)
Errors are application/problem+json with code; log/error output scanned in test contains no customer name, amount tied to a customer, or token (ARC-I-010)
OpenAPI conformance: every route registered in chi (kernel routes plus app routes from Registry.Routes) exists in openapi.yaml and vice versa; responses validated against schema in handler tests
Apps mount routes only through Registry.Routes(r chi.Router); a route that sets state owned by a gate effect is refused by the route-table test unless it is the gate decision endpoint

tasks.title: kernel/ledger: double-entry engine, periods, reversals
accept: Insert unbalanced entry -> error from deferred trigger journal_balanced (BIL-I-001)
Reversal mirrors original lines exactly with swapped sides (BIL-I-019); UPDATE/DELETE on journal_line refused
Posting dated into a closed period -> refused; correction posts in current period (BIL-I-025)
Property test: after N random valid postings, trial balance sums to 0; Post is idempotent per (source_kind, source_id)
Accounts, books and posting templates are app data (Registry.ChartOfAccounts); the engine knows no account code

tasks.title: kernel webhooks out (Standard Webhooks)
accept: Signature header v1,<base64 HMAC> verifies with the Standard Webhooks reference test vector
Ordered per (endpoint, subject): event 2 not sent until event 1 acked
Event types are registered by modules with a JSON Schema; an unregistered type cannot be emitted

tasks.title: kernel/docs: documents, versions, page/line text, citations, retention engine
accept: Document kinds are registered by the app (DocumentKind{ID, Templates, Classification, RetentionClass}); upload of an unregistered kind -> 422
Text is stored per version as pages and lines; quote_hash = sha256(NFC text of cited lines) verified at render; a citation to a changed version fails verification (ARC-I-037)
Document text never in logs or audit detail; bytes in the cell bucket only (ARC-U-012)
Retention engine: classes are app data (min_years, never_purge, destruction_gate); a purge run only proposes a list; nothing is destroyed until the class's destruction gate is approved

tasks.title: kernel/work: work items, boards, workflows, automation
accept: Automation run append-only; automation cannot fire money or external effects without a gate
Work items attach to any registered subject kind (subject_kind, subject_id); the app registers its subject kinds

tasks.title: kernel/deadline: deadline engine with pluggable rule packs
accept: Rule pack interface: versioned YAML data (trigger events, offsets, day-count mode clear/business/calendar, months_after, holiday calendar, roll-forward rule) validated by spec/kernel/rulepack.schema.json; the helpdesk fixture pack computes its golden dates
Every computed deadline needs human confirmation (deadline_confirmation append-only); a pack version change re-computes unconfirmed deadlines only
Reminder worker sends even when the agent is down; no reminder > 24 h late (SLO-04); falls back to the second notifier (ARC-U-030)

tasks.title: kernel notifications and external portal shell
accept: Notifications: channel (in-app, email) per user preference; every notification has a template id registered by a module and carries no document text
Portal shell: guest identity, magic-link or OIDC sign-in, session; pages are registered by the app (PortalPage{ID, Route, Capability, Loader}); a guest sees only subjects its grant lists

tasks.title: kernel/agenttools: agent tool interface (drafts, gates, plan/steps, citations)
accept: Tools are registered by modules (Tool{Name, Kind read|report|write, InputSchema, Capability, Handler}); each validates input against its JSON Schema; write tool before report_plan -> 409 plan_required (ARC-I-039)
Write tools create drafts/proposals or open gates only; agent principal deciding any gate -> 403
Prompt-injection fixture inside a document is returned as quoted data and does not change tool calls (ARC-I-038)
Tool results that quote documents carry citations in the kernel citation shape

tasks.title: kernel/report: report definitions, runs, schedules, exports
accept: Report definitions are registered (ReportDef{ID, Params schema, Capability, Run(ctx, tx, params) -> rows}); a run stores params hash and row count, never row data in audit
Scheduled runs go through River; CSV and PDF render with a sha256 manifest

tasks.title: kernel access admin, break-glass, reviews, offboarding
accept: Role change via gate kind core.role_change (GA1), user activation via core.user_activation (GA2)
Break-glass opens time-boxed grant and audit event; auto-expires
Access review and offboarding plans list grants from every registered capability, including app ones

tasks.title: kernel/importer: import framework (staging, id map, dry run, checkpoints)
accept: Sources are registered by the app (Source{ID, Resources, Extract, Transform}); extraction checkpoints per resource cursor and resumes after a kill (MIG-004)
Every imported row has exactly one id_map row; rerun transform on same snapshot -> zero changes (MIG-007, MIG-008); duplicates flagged, never auto-merged (MIG-014)
Dry run lists unmapped resource types and fields with counts (MIG-012, MIG-013); import cannot start without a zero-error dry run on the same snapshot approved through the import gate (MIG-015)
Instants stored UTC, date-only fields unshifted (MIG-006)

tasks.title: Cell deploy, backups, DR, rollout rings
accept: Helm render for 2 cells: no shared resource name, DSN, bucket, KMS ARN or secret (ARC-U-001 guard test)

Restore drill script restores PITR into a scratch namespace and runs every app-registered restore check (Counsel: trust three-way check); yearly all-cells drill restores 8 cells in parallel within the stated time (ARC-U-043)
Month-end export object exists in the DR bucket before its DB row commits (ARC-U-042); SLO-05b bucket replication lag alert renders

Migration job lock_timeout=2s; expand-contract lint rejects DROP/RENAME/NOT NULL without default in release N (ARC-U-017, MIG-060, MIG-061); backfills run in batches of <= 10000 rows with a pause (MIG-062); rollout rehearsed on a snapshot, then cell by cell (MIG-064, MIG-065)
Two requests on one pooled connection: counsel.user_id is empty at the start of the second (SET LOCAL only); River connects directly, not via PgBouncer (ARC-U-011)
Shared control plane config contains no customer data (ARC-U-004); WAF rate rule 2000 req/5 min per IP rendered (ARC-U-038); losing both sync standbys needs an operator decision (ARC-U-007)

tasks.title: Observability, SLOs, degraded modes, status page
accept: SLO-01..10 have recording rules + alerts; synthetic check logs in with synthetic user every 60 s
With Paploo down: every app-registered smoke check passes (Counsel: matters, time, billing, trust, deadlines) (ARC-U-028)
Feature flag without owner or expiry -> config load fails (ARC-U-019); dead letter older than 1 business day pages; replay is an explicit admin action and idempotent (ARC-U-024)
Purge jobs refuse every retention class marked never_purge (Counsel: trust, financial, billing) (ARC-U-013)

tasks.title: Web shell (kernel)
accept: Generated client from openapi.yaml; unknown enum renders 'Other' (ARC-I-002)
Money rendered from cents via one formatter; no float arithmetic in web/src (lint)
Navigation, routes and screens come from the app's registered feature list; the shell renders with the helpdesk fixture and no app/legal code

tasks.title: Import legal rule, gate and access data
accept: spec/rules/*.json is the union of b1,b2,b3,a1,a2,a3 rules; a test asserts every rule id is unique and matches ^(BIL-[LTCI]|ARC-[UI]|MIG)-?\d{3}$
spec/gates.json and spec/access.json validate against spec/kernel gate-kind and capability schemas

tasks.title: Legal roles, capabilities, walls resolver
accept: Table test generated from legal-spec access.json: for every (role, capability) cell, Can() returns the matrix value (access-matrix test)
Agent acting for clerk cannot billing.approve; module names are the a4 schemas and gate kinds use them (a2 renamed_gate_kinds)
Walls SubjectResolver: walled user gets 404 on the matter and its documents, deadlines, work items

tasks.title: Legal gate kinds and self-approval policy
accept: Every gate in spec/gates.json registers as a kind; gate_code is the kind slug (billing.bill_approval) and spec_gate keeps the spec id (G-B2); a code like G-B2 in gate_code is rejected (CF-04)
Sole-practitioner SelfApprovalPolicy only when exactly 1 active licensee and setting on; self_approval_exception=true recorded (ARC-I-021)
24 h cooling-off applies to trust.withdrawal, trust.transfer, trust.reconciliation_signoff, trust.regulatory_release
Every gated legal transition stores a decision by a human with the capability who is not the preparer (BIL-I-021)

tasks.title: Operating books: chart of accounts and posting templates
accept: Chart OP-*/TR-* registered with the ledger engine; OP entry with TR-1500 line -> error (BIL-I-002)
Property test: OP-1100+OP-1110 = sum(open bill balances); OP-2200 = sum(client credit) (BIL-I-013)
gl.vendor_bill is owned by app/legal/books (app table in a kernel schema, listed in kernel_bindings.txt)

tasks.title: Matter core: matter, matter_member, minimal party (no conflicts UI)
accept: matter.matter, matter.matter_member and party.contact rows can be created through the module API so money tasks have FK targets; no conflict check or intake UI yet
Other modules read matters only through the matter query API or api_matter view (ARC-I-041 layering test)

tasks.title: Trust: accounts, signatories, client ledgers, receipts
accept: Receipt of 150000 to client A ledger posts trust_transaction and ledger balance = 150000; TR-1500 = sum(TR-2500) per account (BIL-I-009)

Cash on one client file, trust receipts plus operating cash payments together: 500000 + 249999 = 749999 -> allowed; 500000 + 250000 = 750000 -> 409 cash_limit unless an exception code with evidence (G6c); warning at 600000 (BIL-L-039, $7,500 or more, verify)

NSF on a receipt already paid out: reversal plus a replenishing receipt from the general account for exactly the shortfall in one tx, ledger ends at 0, trust exception opened; if the ledger still covers it, reversal only

32 goroutines each withdraw a fixed amount from one ledger: count(committed) * amount <= starting balance, and every rejected call returns 409 insufficient_trust_funds, never 500 or a deadlock error (BIL-I-010, integration)
No trust receipt accepted on an account without an active signatory (MIG-035)

tasks.title: Trust withdrawals, transfers, EFT authorization
accept: Withdrawal to payee 'cash' or 'bearer' -> 422 (BIL-L-037)
Withdrawal only via gate effect: approve by signatory -> RecordExecution by different user when 2 people exist (ARC-I-027)
Effect re-checks ledger balance at execution: ledger 10000, approved withdrawal 12000 -> effect fails, no posting (ARC-I-024)

The trust transaction posts when execution is recorded (dated executed_on); bank confirmation only matches the bank line. available = cleared posted - protected - minimum - authorized-not-executed: two concurrent authorizations of 300000 on a 500000 ledger -> second 409 trust_overdraw
Withdrawal against an uncleared receipt -> 409 uncleared_funds (default hard block)
Replay the withdrawal effect 3 times concurrently -> 1 trust_transaction (trust_txn_once_per_withdrawal) and 1 gate.effect_execution row

No endpoint sets a withdrawal executed without an approved gate; POST /trust/withdrawals/{id}/execution only records bank confirmation by a user distinct from the authorizer after the withdrawal is authorized and unexpired, else 409 not_authorized (ARC-I-012, ARC-I-027): route table test

tasks.title: Trust bank import and monthly three-way reconciliation
accept: Bank 1000000, book 1000000, sum client ledgers 1000000 -> reconciled; one 500-cent difference -> unreconciled with reconciling item required
Signing reconciliation locks the month: later posting dated in month -> refused (BIL-I-025)
Month-end immutable export (CSV+PDF) written with sha256 manifest (ARC-U-014)

tasks.title: Tax rates and place-of-supply engine
accept: Seeded TaxRate rows match BIL-T-001 (HST ON 130000 ppm; NS 150000 before 2025-04-01, 140000 from); lookup(NS,HST,2025-03-31)=150000
decision_table rows of b2-sales-tax.json run as table test: every row's inputs give its expected tax lines
BN '123456789RT0001' with bad check digit -> approval refused (BIL-T-061, BIL-C-201)
Litigation place-of-supply (BIL-T-012) and Indian Act s.87 relief (BIL-T-017) run behind flags that are off until V-TAX is confirmed

tasks.title: Rate resolution and time rounding
accept: Resolution chain tiers 1..8 table test: first hit wins in BIL-C-003 order; manual rate without time.rates -> 403
Rate change effective 2026-10-01 re-prices unbilled entries dated >= 2026-10-01 only (BIL-C-004)
raw 7 min, increment 6, mode up -> 12; nearest -> 6; amount rhu(12*45000,60)=9000 (BIL-C-010/011)
Matter move keeps tier-1 manual rate and sets rate_recheck=true (BIL-C-005)

tasks.title: Time entries, timers, suggestions, approvals
accept: State machine TimeEntry from b3 state_machines: suggested->accepted only with G9 by entry owner; agent-suggested entry never auto-accepted
Write-down row changes bill line amount, never TimeEntry.minutes (BIL-C-013)
Entry on a non-void bill cannot be edited -> 409
Paralegal timekeeper on an activity outside the paralegal scope list -> entry flagged and blocked from billing (BIL-L-046)

tasks.title: Bill draft builder: lines, reductions, discounts
accept: b3 examples[] run verbatim as golden tests (each example's inputs -> exact cents)
Bill discount 100000 ppm (10%) on fees 100000 + own-cost 20000 + agent 7000: discount 12000 spread by largest remainder on fee/own lines only; agent line untouched (BIL-C-020/022)
Discount never makes a line negative (BIL-C-021)
Markup 100000 ppm on own cost 5000 -> 500, taxable; markup on agent disbursement -> 422; agent disbursement carries no HST on rebill (BIL-C-041, BIL-T-033, BIL-L-048)
Aggregated disbursement without per-item date/description -> delivery blocked (BIL-L-002)

tasks.title: Bill tax computation and totals
accept: Tax once per tax line, not per line: three lines 3333+3333+3334 at 130000 ppm -> rhu(10000*130000,1e6)=1300 (not 433+433+433=1299)
Property test BIL-I-004: total = sum(line.net)+sum(tax) for random drafts
Client-sent totals ignored; server recomputes with rate_ppm/1e6 (ARC-I-028)
Tax point = earlier of paid and due; due = bill date (approval date, Toronto): bill approved 2026-10-31 in an October-filing period reports its tax in October (BIL-T-050)

tasks.title: Bill approval, numbering, immutability, signature, delivery
accept: No endpoint sets bill.status=approved except the G-B2 effect (route table test); approve via G-B2 effect only: number assigned in approval tx, prefix-YYYY-NNNN gapless (BIL-C-120)
UPDATE of any line/amount/tax/number on approved bill -> trigger error bill_guard (BIL-I-006); discount after approval -> 409 use_credit_note
Deliver without licensee signature or signed cover letter -> 409 SIGNATURE_REQUIRED (BIL-L-001 test)
Delivered PDF shows interest rate, GST/HST number, assessment notice (BIL-L-007, BIL-L-009, BIL-T-060)
Approval posts DR OP-1100 / CR OP-4000 + tax liability per b3 journal[]; sums match bill.total; replaying the approval effect 3 times concurrently -> 1 journal entry (journal_once_per_source)

delivered_at changes only from NULL to a value <= now(), set by the delivery effect on evidence (email accepted 2026-10-03T23:30-04:00 -> business date 2026-10-03; PATCH delivered_at -> 422 read_only_field; bounce leaves it NULL) (ARC-I-052); UPDATE 2026-10-03 -> 2026-09-01 -> bill_guard error; interest_rate_ppm, place_of_supply, due_date, approver and signature frozen after approval

Paralegal bill shows fees and disbursements separately (BIL-L-044); Solicitors Act features on paralegal bills stay behind a flag until BIL-L-045 is confirmed; every bill line maps to a disclosed fee basis, no hidden charges (BIL-L-027)

tasks.title: Void and place-of-supply change
accept: Void approved-not-delivered bill keeps its number, posts exact reversal, frees its time entries so they can go on a new bill (requires CF-08 fix)
Void runs only through gate billing.bill_void (G-B2) and creates no credit_note row; void of a delivered bill -> 409 bill_delivered_use_credit_note (BIL-C-084, ARC-I-050, CF-20)
Place of supply change after delivery -> full credit note + new bill; never returns to draft (BIL-C-207)

tasks.title: Payments: capture, allocation, overpayment, refunds, reversals
accept: Payment 50000 on bill fees 80000 + tax 10400 (open 90400): tax share rhu(50000*10400,90400)=5752, pre 44248 to fee bucket (BIL-C-202/061)
Duplicate provider webhook (same provider,event_id) -> one payment (BIL-I-020)

Overpayment -> unapplied allocation, then client credit OP-2200 on G-B3; credit is short-lived: untouched 6 business days (default N=5) -> exception task 'client money in operating'; resolved by applying to a delivered bill, refund (G-B6) or payment into trust (G6); never to another client (BIL-C-063)
Payment allocation to a bill is capped at balance minus reserved trust fee transfers; excess goes to unapplied (RV1-002)
Retainer money received into operating -> refused; general receipts journal records each payment against the bill it pays (BIL-I-016, BIL-L-042)
NSF reversal restores each allocation's bucket split exactly (BIL-C-065)
Refund, dispute and chargeback events apply by state precedence: dispute before capture -> payment created then reversed once, capture replayed after refund -> no change (ARC-I-048, BIL-C-068)
Property: sum(allocations)+refunds+reversals = amount for every payment (BIL-I-012)

tasks.title: Trust applied to fees
accept: Apply trust to undelivered bill -> 409 not_delivered (BIL-L-035)
Amount > min(bill balance - reserved transfers, available cleared unprotected ledger balance) -> 409
Disbursement paid from trust needs the trust withdrawal gate G11 and a client-direction record (BIL-C-042)
auto_apply_trust_on_approval creates proposed transfer only; still needs G-B4/G11 (BIL-C-052)
Retainer receipt in trust posts no tax; tax arises on application to bill (BIL-T-051)

tasks.title: Credit notes and write-offs
accept: Credit 20000 pre-tax on bill with tax 13000 on base 100000: tax rhu(20000*13000,100000)=2600 using source bill rate even after rate change (BIL-C-203/BIL-T-070)
Credit beyond remaining pre-tax per bucket -> 422 (BIL-C-082/BIL-I-014)
Write-off via G-B5 by lawyer not requester; open tax posts bad-debt adjustment (BIL-C-205)

tasks.title: Interest on overdue accounts
accept: Delivered 2026-01-15: interest 0 for every day through 2026-02-15; accrues from 2026-02-16 (BIL-I-023, BIL-L-008) (verify one-month computation)
Simple actual/365: principal 100000, rate snapshot 120000 ppm, 31 days -> rhu(100000*120000*31, 1e6*365)=1019
Bill without agreed rate -> no interest ever (BIL-L-010)
Interest line carries no HST (BIL-C-204, BIL-L-049)

tasks.title: Assessment, collection holds and fee repayment
accept: Collection action (suit referral) disabled until the day after months_after(delivery_local_date,1): delivered 2026-01-28 -> blocked on 2026-02-28, allowed 2026-03-01 (BIL-L-004, verify)

Assessment requisition recorded within one month of delivery stops reminders and interest posting on that bill; after one month the screen requires the special-circumstances note (BIL-L-005); payment does not close the assessment option (BIL-L-006)
Assessment result reducing fees -> credit note and refund of overpayment within the firm's repayment window, with interest per the officer's order (BIL-L-011, BIL-L-033)

tasks.title: Split bills, batch billing, combined client bills
accept: Line 10001 split 333300/333300/333400 ppm: others floor -> 3333,3333; first payer 3335 (BIL-C-091)
Batch rerun with same (batch_run_id, matter, period_to) creates no duplicate draft (BIL-C-110)
WIP report flags approved time unbilled past the matter's billing cycle + 30 days so tax is not deferred by holding bills (BIL-T-052)

tasks.title: Card surcharges
accept: Debit card or Quebec client -> surcharge 0 (verify)
BIL-T-044 golden: surcharge_ppm capped at min(24000, cost_ppm); surcharge never posts to trust (BIL-I-015)
Surcharge 2712 on an HST bill carries HST 353 (taxable, verify); refund of a surcharged payment refunds surcharge and its tax pro rata (CF-18)

tasks.title: Fee agreements: contingency, fee splitting, referral fees
accept: Contingency arrangement on family-law matter -> 422 (BIL-L-016)
Recovery 1000000, pct 300000 ppm -> fee 300000; fee > recovery base -> approval refused (BIL-C-033)
Settlement statement: disbursements and taxes reimbursed first, client direction recorded before any payment from the recovery (BIL-L-022, BIL-L-023)
Fee agreement template with a negligence-release clause -> publish refused (BIL-L-014); court-matter agreement flagged for court approval (BIL-L-013)
Fee split to an outside licensee needs client consent record; any referral or split payee who is not a licensee -> 422 (BIL-L-030, BIL-L-031, BIL-L-032)

tasks.title: Parties, contacts, relationships (merged entity)
accept: intake.Contact and matters.Contact both map to party.contact (a4 merges[]); lead->matter conversion keeps contact id
Field list = a4 party.contact columns only; no invented columns for o2 entity stubs

tasks.title: Conflicts: checks, hits, clearance, walls, ID records
accept: Check run is append-only; G2 clearance by lawyer other than preparer

conflicts.issue: Percent unit. b3 stores discounts, markup, splits, interest, contingency in basis points (/10000; BIL-C-021, BIL-C-041, BIL-C-091, BIL-C-071 bill.interest_rate_bp). a4 stores them as ppm (bill_split.share_ppm, expense.markup_ppm, payment_profile.interest_ppm, fee_arrangement.contingency_ppm). a2 ARC-I-028 computes HST as rate_bp/10000, which cannot hold QST 9.975% (99750 ppm).
conflicts.resolution: One unit everywhere: every rate and percentage is integer parts per million (/1e6), money is integer cents. b3 restates discounts, markup, splits, interest and contingency in ppm (e.g. bill.interest_rate_ppm); a4 keeps its *_ppm columns; a2 ARC-I-028 uses rate_ppm/1e6. No bp type exists in code.
conflicts.status_note: ppm everywhere: b3 converts bp to ppm, a2 ARC-I-028 uses rate_ppm, a4 keeps *_ppm (b3, a2 owners); o1 tasks restated in ppm

conflicts.issue: Ledger shape. b3 models trust as double-entry TR-1500/TR-2500 lines in one journal with a book per entry (BIL-I-001, BIL-I-002, BIL-I-009). a4 gl.journal_entry has no book column, and trust is a separate single-entry trust.trust_transaction table.
conflicts.resolution: Keep a4 trust.trust_transaction as the By-Law 9 book of record (one row per client-ledger movement); derive TR-1500/TR-2500 balances from it; gl holds operating only. Restate BIL-I-001/002/009 against that shape (I-009: per account, bank control = sum(client ledgers)). Owner to confirm.
conflicts.status_note: owner confirmation; a4 trust.trust_transaction stays the book of record, b3 restates BIL-I-001/002/009 against it

conflicts.issue: Missing tables. a4 DDL has no outbox, inbox/processed messages, idempotency_keys, effect_executions, gate_versions (ARC-I-008/015/023/030, ARC-U-022), no payment_event (BIL-I-020), interest_charge (BIL-C-072), client_credit (BIL-C-063), trust fee transfer (BIL-C-052), write_off (BIL-C-085), feature flags (ARC-U-019).
conflicts.resolution: a4 adds them in 0001 (still pre-release, so not an expand-contract issue) using the column lists a2/b3 imply. Coders must not invent them: T-007, T-008, T-021 stop until the DDL addendum lands.
conflicts.status_note: a4 owns DDL fixes: outbox, inbox, idempotency_key, gate.effect_execution, gate versions, platform.inbound_event, platform.source_subscription, interest_charge, client_credit, fee transfer, write_off, feature_flag added to 0001

conflicts.issue: Gate naming. a2 tables gates/gate_versions/gate_decisions/effect_executions keyed by gate kind <module>.<slug> (ARC-I-013); a4 has gate.approval_request.gate_code + gate.gate_decision. a2 gate_kinds still list 'GA1 (trust)', 'GA2 (trust)' that o2 renamed to G-TSIG/G-TREL.
conflicts.resolution: Use a4 table names. gate.approval_request.gate_code holds the kind slug (CHECK ^[a-z]+\.[a-z_]+$, e.g. billing.bill_approval) and a new column spec_gate holds the spec id (G-B2, G-TREL); the 24 h cooling-off trigger matches kind slugs (trust.withdrawal, trust.transfer, trust.reconciliation_signoff, trust.regulatory_release). a2 gate_kinds regenerated with the o2 renames (RV2-001).
conflicts.status_note: closed with RV2-001: gate_code = kind slug, spec_gate column (a4, a2 owners)

conflicts.issue: Module and table names disagree for 17 of 18 a2 modules: identity vs core, books vs gl, gates vs gate, events/firm vs platform, deadlines vs cal, documents vs docs, conflicts vs conflict, matters vs matter+party, time vs timekeeping, portal vs comms. a2 table names are plural (bills), a4 singular (billing.bill). Ownership differs for break_glass (identity vs audit), availability (work vs core), portal_access (portal vs comms).
conflicts.resolution: DDL schema = Go package = owning module (source order: DDL > screens; a2 module list is not a contract). a2 now uses the a4 names; its module_rename and renamed_gate_kinds keys become docs/MODULES.md; ARC-I-040/041 apply to a4 schemas. Capability ids (documents.release, time.rates) keep their names.
conflicts.status_note: a2 applied (f4): 17 modules = a4 schemas, 58 gate kinds renamed (documents.* -> docs.*, deadlines.* -> cal.*, matters.* -> matter.*, conflicts.* -> conflict.*, time.* -> timekeeping.*, access.* -> core.*, readiness.* -> platform.*, books.* -> gl.*); map in a2 module_rename / renamed_gate_kinds, copied to docs/MODULES.md; capability names unchanged

conflicts.issue: Tenancy. a4: database per cell, no firm_id. a2 event envelope has firm_id (ARC-I-031) and idempotency is keyed (firm, principal, key) (ARC-I-008).
conflicts.resolution: firm_id in envelopes and idempotency is the constant cell firm id from core.firm; no firm_id column on domain tables.
conflicts.status_note: accepted as written; no firm_id on domain tables

conflicts.issue: Two gates for trust signatory change: trust G-TSIG (approver responsible lawyer) and access GA6 (owner with signing authority + second signatory). o2 open item.
conflicts.resolution: Use GA6 (stricter, two-person). Drop G-TSIG or alias it to GA6. Owner decision; T-039L, T-011 signatory flows wait.
conflicts.status_note: GA6 (kind core.trust_signatory) is canonical; trust.signing_authority (G-TSIG) and legal-spec trust.json G-TSIG are aliases that route to it

conflicts.issue: bill_line has unconditional UNIQUE(time_entry_id) and UNIQUE(expense_id). BIL-I-007 requires uniqueness only among non-void bills, and BIL-C-084 says void unlocks entries for a new bill. With a4 as written, void-and-rebill is impossible.
conflicts.resolution: Replace with a partial unique index on a denormalised bill_line.bill_status <> 'void', or move the lock to time_entry.billed_bill_id. a4 to amend.
conflicts.status_note: a4 replaces unconditional UNIQUE with a partial unique index excluding void bills

conflicts.issue: Bill columns. b3 needs bill.interest_rate_bp snapshot (BIL-C-071), confirmed place_of_supply (BIL-C-201/207), signer user id + signature hash (BIL-L-001); a4 billing.bill has only signature_ref and no rate or place-of-supply column. b3 'bill date = approval date' (BIL-C-121) vs a4 issue_date (unspecified).
conflicts.resolution: Add to billing.bill: interest_rate_ppm (NULL = no interest), interest_terms_doc_id, place_of_supply jsonb {jurisdiction, rule_applied, confirmed_by, confirmed_at}, signed_by, signed_at, signature_hash; add billing.interest_charge. bill_guard freezes them plus due_date, approved_by/at, and delivered_at (NULL to a value <= now() only); void requires delivered_at IS NULL (RV1-008, RV1-013). issue_date := approval date (Toronto).
conflicts.status_note: a4 adds the bill columns and bill_guard freeze (RV1-008, RV1-013), in ppm

conflicts.issue: BIL-T-002 says the tax point is in 'BIL-T-030', which is the disbursement rule; tax point is BIL-T-050. BIL-T-002 also says 'payment applied and bill issue date' while BIL-T-050 says 'paid and due'.
conflicts.resolution: Fix reference to BIL-T-050. Treat 'due' = bill date (approval date, BIL-C-121); a trust retainer is not payment until applied (BIL-T-051).
conflicts.status_note: b2 corrects the BIL-T-002 reference to BIL-T-050

conflicts.issue: Trust-to-fees approval: b3 cites both G-B4 and G11 (BIL-C-052) and G11 for disbursements from trust (BIL-C-042); legal-spec trust renamed gates (G-TREL). Which single gate kind authorizes a fee transfer is unclear.
conflicts.resolution: One gate kind billing.trust_fee_withdrawal (spec id G-B4) with min_approvers 1 signatory; trust.withdrawal (G11) stays the generic trust withdrawal.
conflicts.status_note: one gate kind billing.trust_fee_withdrawal (spec G-B4), only after delivery, up to min(bill balance less reserved, available trust); legal-spec billing.json aligned

conflicts.issue: ARC-I-029 requires leftover payment to be an explicit 'unapplied' allocation; b3 BIL-C-063 sends excess to ClientCredit (OP-2200) behind G-B3.
conflicts.resolution: Unapplied allocation exists only while G-B3 is pending; on approval it becomes client credit. Both rules hold.
conflicts.status_note: unapplied allocation while G-B3 is pending, then client credit; credit is short-lived (5 business days default, verify) per RV1-006; billing.json aligned

conflicts.resolution: Both layers: Can() is the authority; RLS is defence in depth on walled content. Add RLS to billing.bill, trust.client_ledger, party.contact (wall-relevant) in a4.

conflicts.issue: Surcharge cap 2.4% (24000 ppm) and conditions (BIL-C-100/101) are card-network rules, not law cited; Quebec prohibition not stated.
conflicts.resolution: Surcharge is taxable at the paid bill's tax codes, pro rata, and refunds include the surcharge and its tax pro rata (b2 BIL-T-044, verify; b3 BIL-C-204/BIL-J-013/BIL-X-013: 2712 -> HST 353, charged 116065). Ship T-026 behind a flag off by default until CRA guidance and card-network rules are verified (RV1-007).
conflicts.status_note: b2 BIL-T-044 added (taxable, verify); b3 updates BIL-C-204/BIL-J-013/BIL-X-013; flag stays off

conflicts.issue: Enums and states disagree: bill status (a4 in_review/issued vs b3 pending_approval/preflight_failed/delivered/credited), time_entry status (a4 lacks suggested/accepted/on_draft_bill/rejected), time_entry.rate_source (a4 4 values vs b3 8 tiers), payment status, credit_note.kind (a4 tax_correction/void/write_off vs b3 billing_error/bad_debt_write_off/refund) and credit_note status 'void', withdrawal_request vs TrustFeeTransfer states (RV1-019).
conflicts.resolution: b3 state_machines are the source. a4 CHECK lists are copied verbatim from b3; credit_note status 'void' is dropped and issued credit notes get an immutability trigger; rate_source = manual, flat_activity, matter_user, matter_role, client_user, client_role, activity, user_default. Withdrawal states: proposed, pending_authorization, authorized, executed (posted), confirmed (RV1-002).
conflicts.status_note: a4 copies b3 state lists into CHECKs; b3 renames withdrawal states (RV1-002)

conflicts.issue: a2 voidBill opens a full credit-note gate for any approved bill; b3 BIL-C-084 allows void only before delivery, with an exact reversal and no credit note (RV1-009).
conflicts.resolution: voidBill allowed only when status=approved and delivered_at IS NULL, behind gate kind billing.bill_void (spec G-B2) decided by someone other than the preparer; the effect posts the BIL-J-012 reversal and frees entries. Delivered bill -> 409 bill_delivered_use_credit_note; corrections go through /credit-notes.
conflicts.status_note: a2 applied: voidBill, gate billing.bill_void, ARC-I-050 (f4); a4 removes credit_note kind void
